descriptions.excel_feed: Batch topic list upload and linking to Plan nodes for bulk generation.
descriptions.storage: Stores files from incoming connections and uploads. Dedicated folder per node.
descriptions.style_extract: Reference video analysis agent: visual style, voiceover, editing, narrative → style passport. LLM call limits and cost estimation.
descriptions.shot_menu: Shot menu node: horizontal timeline of voiceover cells and shots. Database fields for actions, camera, setting, prompts.
descriptions.topic: Topic defines the main theme of the video.
descriptions.plan: Video concept: topic, target audience, and hook.
descriptions.script: Voiceover text timed to video duration (~14 chars/sec).
descriptions.scene_design: Complex scene design: characters, world, style, camera angles, and actions.
descriptions.items: Recurring props and object reference images.
descriptions.excel_gpt: AI scene table editor: roles, file piping, disk reconciliation. API without browser. Control via V-menu.
descriptions.image_prompts: Generation of detailed image prompts for each frame.
descriptions.animation_prompts: Video motion prompt generation per frame.
descriptions.videos: Video clip generation from keyframe images.
descriptions.sfx_plan: Sound design timeline cue sheet (timing, category, prompt, volume).
descriptions.sfx_gen: Sound effects generation via ElevenLabs SFX API or local synthesis.
descriptions.audio: ElevenLabs TTS voiceover and Whisper subtitles.
descriptions.assemble: FFmpeg render: video + audio + subtitles → final MP4.
descriptions.publish: Export and publishing to TikTok, Shorts, Reels, VK, Likee.
descriptions.hitl_style: Approval of style passport and presets.
